### 5. M3-ACE Paper Details (arXiv:2603.08369)

- **Approach:** Multi-agent context engineering framework that decouples perception and reasoning. Uses multiple VLM agents collaboratively plus a Summary Tool and Refine Tool (lightweight, not code interpreters).
- **Not tool-augmented in the Python/code-interpreter sense** -- it is a multi-agent orchestration framework.
- **Base models tested:** Gemini-3 Pro, Gemini-2.5 Pro, GPT-5, Claude-4.5 Sonnet
- **Key MathVision results:**
  - Gemini-3 Pro baseline (CoT): 85.0% --> M3-ACE: 89.1% (+4.1)
  - GPT-5 baseline (CoT): 72.0% --> M3-ACE: 82.2% (+10.2)
  - Claude-4.5 Sonnet baseline: 61.2% --> M3-ACE: 76.5% (+15.3)
- **Finding:** Most failures come from incorrect visual evidence extraction (~60% accuracy), not reasoning (~90% accuracy). Multi-agent collaborative perception fixes this.
